purpose: expanded held-out document-role gold. Independent ground truth for evaluating any classifier — deterministic or model — on the document-role question.
supersedes: nothing. new2-heldout-key.json (87 rows, uniform draw) remains valid as a RATE estimate on the Tier-A-admitted population; this is the stratified EVALUATION set it could not be.
caveats: STRATIFIED. Re-weight by stratumPopulationEstimated before quoting any figure as a corpus rate.
One labeller, NEW2, and no model was consulted for any verdict. Every row carries the sentence the verdict rests on so it can be overturned by reading the document.
Judged from the cause title and the operative tail. Where the tail is a service list the verdict is UNCERTAIN and flagged tailIsFooter, not guessed.
BAIL is reported apart from PROCEDURAL deliberately: judges cite bail orders, and calling them impure was a NEW2 error already corrected.
FALSE_PROCEDURAL means the stored class says procedural and the document does not. It is a defect in NEW2's own classifier, recorded against NEW2.
storedClassAtKeyTime is evidence, not truth. The classifier is walking as this is written.
